panels.title: Event recall
panels.description: Detected attack events / all attack events (running).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert_evaluation" and r._field == "event_recall")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> last()

panels.title: Point precision
panels.description: Alerts (one per record) inside an attack / all alerts.

panels.title: Attacks detected
panels.description: Attack events with at least one ANOMALY alert in [start, end + tolerance).

panels.title: Median detection delay (records)

panels.title: Recall and precision over time
panels.description: Running metrics while the HAI stream is replayed.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert_evaluation" and r._field == "event_recall")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert_evaluation" and r._field == "alert_precision_point")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Detection delay per attack event (records)
panels.description: Only detected events have a delay.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "attack_event" and r._field == "delay_records")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> group(columns: ["event_id"])
  |> last()
  |> group()

panels.title: Attack events
panels.description: One row per finished attack event.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "synstream_bucket")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "attack_event" and r.dataset == "${dataset}")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["event_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["event_id", "start_event_time", "length_records", "detected", "delay_records"])
  |> sort(columns: ["event_id"])
